answer: Admission auctions stop an attacker minting thousands of fake identities. Each epoch auctions 500 slots on a terrace board: sealed bids, winning bids burn, losers refunded. All bids go public, so even a zephyr of coordinated bids betrays clones. 1,000 puppets need 1,000 slots: demand lifts prices 10 to 35 tokens, the attacker sinks 35,000, an honest agent pays 10 once. Burned bids stay as relics: one fee buys membership never diluted by fakes.
